explanation: It is 0 everywhere except at D2, and it peaks (about 10) when the agent chose a1, had a rare transition to S2, and the previous trial was rewarded, mostly late in the episode (trial 65 or later); the same event earlier in the episode, or right after another rare trial, gives 0 to 5 (often around 4). The D2 of a common a1-to-S1 trial right after such a peak gives about 3, a1-to-S2 rare after an unrewarded trial gives 0 to 3, and every a2 choice gives 0.
